items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Do you remember Butterbean's being in it?

ctx.x: Do you remember? Yeah. Well, I must have, I wasn't in but one. So I must have been in the later one then, because I think it was, I don't think it was cool when I was in it, and I think it must have been, I must have been in the later one.

Do you remember Butterbean's being in it? Sure. Because he spoke about being in it, and he said that one of them ran all night long, and he left at four o'clock in the morning and was still going. Do you remember something like that, that had so much talent that they just didn't?
When I left, when I left it was still going on. Mm-hmm.
